name: @lattice/demo
description: LAMP ROAD — the first gallery exhibit. A valley at dusk, and the proof that the seams fit.
$comment: Eight of nine. @lattice/persist is the one that is absent, and that is a finding rather than an oversight: this exhibit has no save, per docs/GALLERY.md, so nothing in the gallery plan yet depends on it. @lattice/ui was declared and unimported for a whole iteration because the HUD was drawn into the canvas; it is the overlay now, which is what GALLERY.md made a rule.
